high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the website decrypt.co, as indicated by the URL at the top of the browser. The content of the page discusses the introduction of three core components by EigenCloud: EigenVerify for dispute resolution, EigenDA for data availability, and EigenCompute for execution. The text explains that these new components enable developers to build applications that handle tasks outside the blockchain while preserving cryptographic verification.
